newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay sugar prices end steady on lower demand.
newsitem.headline: Bombay sugar prices end steady on lower demand.

text.p: Bombay sugar prices held steady in a narrow price band on Monday, dealers said.
"Consumer demand as well as retail interest remained negligible but scattered arrivals kept market at the previous level," one dealer said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 remained quiet at 1,230/1,260 rupees while M-30 was steady at 1,255/1,335 rupees. Trading volumes were low as big players awaited the free sale quota for next month by the Indian government.
The quota for December is 800,000 tonnes while traders were expecting 700,000-725,000 tonnes for January.
